summary: A monthly (4th Friday, 9-10am) open networking meetup for local entrepreneurs at Atlanta Bread Co on Hendersonville Road, run by Incredible Towns of WNC as a coffee-hour counterpart to their IBN biz lunches. It is explicitly "No Membership Fees, No Attendance Requirements, No Exclusions" - a rotating drop-in crowd, not a fixed-membership club, matching the verdict reached for the five sibling IBN chapters.

evidence.note: Listing describes it as free, no dues/fees, no membership, no attendance requirements, attendees told to bring business cards to swap - a promotional networking mixer format.

Only 2 sparse listings over 2 years (July 2024, Sept 2026), same venue/description each time, organizer Incredible Towns of WNC - low, irregular cadence typical of a promotional meetup rather than an organized club.

Parent org's page calls this the "IBN Coffee Connection" (site's name differs from the Eventbrite listing's "Coffee Club"), meeting monthly 4th Friday 9-10am with pre/post optional networking, framed as a shorter morning alternative to the midday IBN biz lunches, not a distinct club.
Same 'no membership fees, no attendance requirements, no category restrictions' philosophy applies to all IBN chapters/events including this one, per the parent org.
